339-677-8201-8250.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

240-5223-5470-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
240-5223-5470-8227.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

2645-3181-3430-3478.easyPrerequisites: Krosan Restorer doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3181-3430-3478.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Krosan Restorer by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Krosan Restorer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2558-2829-4186-6689-8181.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Golbez triggers.
Holding priority, activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager.
Resolve the Golbez trigger, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Repeat from step 2.

147-1893-5147.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1893-5147.description:
Cast Shallow Grave by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Shallow Grave.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Shallow Grave
Resolve the Shallow Grave copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3490-5477-6791-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-5477-6791-7075.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

3108-4247-6972--112.description:
If Grim Poppet has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Grim Poppet has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.
Resolve all Grim Poppet abilities, putting infinite -1/-1 counters on any number of creatures.
3108-4247-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost toughness by at least 1 to prevent Grim Poppet from dying due to the -1/-1 counters. You can perform this combo as a lock whenever a creature enters the battlefield to put -1/-1 counters on that creature and cause it to die.

586-728-944-5258-5618.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6798-6972-7804.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
6798-6972-7804.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Captain Kathryn Janeway.
When Captain Kathryn Janeway dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Captain Kathryn Janeway enters, it triggers, revealing the top card of your library, putting the card back on top of your library, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Kathryn Janeway.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1379-2685-4186-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1379-2685-4186-6824.description:
Gain life in any way.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2946-4871-6798-6887.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-6798-6887.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

647-3259-7659.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-7659.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Brimaz as attackers.
Brimaz triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

323-997-5170-6132.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2438-4452-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
2438-4452-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

1308-3690-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
1308-3690-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Sylvan Awakening
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

261-338-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-338-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

1579-5686-6972--112.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Visionary Augmenter.
When Visionary Augmenter dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Visionary Augmenter enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
1579-5686-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Visionary Augmenter's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

1849-4153-6575--136.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, copying another nonlegendary Saga you control and putting two to three lore counters on it.
The Saga tokens first through fourth chapter abilities trigger, as applicable. Resolve all triggers, and sacrifice the Saga token upon resolving the final trigger.
When the Saga token leaves the battlefield, Resourceful Defense triggers, moving the lore counters from the Saga token onto Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second, third and fourth chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the second and third chapter abilities.
Resolve the fourth chapter ability, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G} and then exiling Esper Terra and returning it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
Resourceful Defense and Terra, Magical Adept trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, moving all counters from Esper Terra onto any other permanent
Resolve the Terra, Magical Adept trigger, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1849-4153-6575--136.notes: The chosen Saga must have no more than four chapter abilities. Once you have infinite white mana, you can instead copy any other permanent besides the chosen Saga, and move counters to and from Esper Terra using Resourceful Defense's ability.

2292-4699-5220-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Overgrowth Elemental trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3227-3647-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
3227-3647-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Scrivener and Peregrine Drake
When Scrivener and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Scrivener trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
3227-3647-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

2232-6558-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control six or more lands.
2232-6558-6749.description:
Cast Naga Fleshcrafter by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Naga Fleshcrafter enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from the battlefield to your hand.
When Anticausal Vestige leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Naga Fleshcrafter from the battlefield to your hand.
When Naga Fleshcrafter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Naga Fleshcrafter from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1418-3389-5954-6664.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-1563-2457-4359.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

851-4559-5686.notablePrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is at least 11.
851-4559-5686.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, creating two Blood tokens.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Bloods, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

392-3705-5231-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Iraxxa and Birgi trigger.
Resolve the Iraxxa trigger, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

311-2034-4424.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
311-2034-4424.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Coral Trickster, adding {C}{C}.
When Coral Trickster dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Coral Trickster from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Coral Trickster's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Coral Trickster triggers, untapping target permanent.
Repeat.

262-4620-4875.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Captain of the Mists.
Captain of the Mists does not have summoning sickness.
"Human" chosen with Conspiracy.
262-4620-4875.description:
Activate Captain of the Mists by tapping it, creating at least two 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield as Humans due to Conspiracy, Captain of the Mists triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

372-2034-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other nonland permanents.
372-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Abdel Adrian, adding {C}{C}.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing all cards exiled with it to return to the battlefield under their owner's control.
Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling two other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

469-3407.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U}{R}, plus an additional {R} if Dual Strike was not foretold, plus enough mana to cast the additional spell if needed
469-3407.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cast an additional instant or sorcery, or an opponent is casting one.
469-3407.description:
Cast any other instant and/or sorcery spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Dual Strike by paying {R}{R}, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast with mana value four or less.
Cast Insidious Will by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting the instant or sorcery spell cast in step 1.
Dual Strike triggers, copying Insidious Will, with the copy targeting the original Insidious Will.
Resolve the copy of Insidious Will, copying Insidious Will, with the copy targeting the original Insidious Will.
Repeat step 5.

1537-4702.easyPrerequisites: Splinter Twin attached to Zealous Conscripts.
1537-4702.description:
Activate Zealous Conscripts by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the token Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping the nontoken Zealous Conscripts.
Repeat.

343-2050-3525.notablePrerequisites:
You control a Forest.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Arbor Elf.
You are the monarch.
343-2050-3525.description:
Activate a Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Regal Behemoth's last ability triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping a Forest.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Arbor Elf.
Repeat.
